- When sentiment is positive (even if low), model tends to overestimate prices; apply downward bias correction.
- After a price spike, model often overshoots in the following days; reduce forecast by 1–2% for the next 3–5 days.
- Model consistently underestimates true price in the first 5–7 days of a new trend; add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for early days.
- If sentiment is neutral or negative, model tends to lag behind true price; adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% for the next 3–7 days.
- Mean reversion is strong in 3–5 day horizons; if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 1–3%.
- For 30-day forecasts, model often overestimates in the first 10 days and underestimates later; apply a “sawtooth” correction: +0.5% for days 1–10, -0.5% for days 11–30.
